name: osman-plugins
description: Free Claude Code plugins by Osman Turalioglu: visual UI change detection and offline prompt linting.

plugins.name: elastishot
plugins.description: Compare two screenshots or two page URLs and get back the regions and DOM locators that changed, even when the layout shifted, zoomed or collapsed. Also runs config-driven visual regression baselines across targets and viewports, with a JUnit CI gate. Wraps the elastishot CLI from npm.

plugins.name: promptfixer-lint
plugins.description: Offline prompt linter. Scores a prompt file 0-100 across clarity, specificity, context, format and structure, and lists each defect with a severity and a fix. Deterministic regex rules only: no model, no network, no API key, no install.
